name: XR_DXR_android_surface_binding
title: Android Surface Binding
summary: App-provided Android Surface / ANativeWindow, republished across background and resume, with the per-frame window rect

name: XR_DXR_atlas_capture
title: Atlas Capture
summary: Vendor-neutral PNG snapshot of the multi-view atlas at a caller-selected compositor stage, for any app class

name: XR_DXR_depth_budget
title: Rear Depth Budget
summary: Advisory limit on how far behind the display plane a transparent app may render, chained on XrViewState at xrLocateViews

name: XR_DXR_display_info
title: Display Info
summary: Display dimensions, eye-tracking modes, and the data needed for asymmetric (Kooima) projection

name: XR_DXR_display_zones
title: Display Zones
summary: A layout of independent 3D zones and flat 2D zones across one display, each 3D zone with its own view rig, plus the wish mask a switchable-lens panel honours

name: XR_DXR_local_3d_zone
title: Local 3D Zones
summary: Per-pixel 3D-ness mask over an app's own window, with the flat 2D side as a first-class post-weave composition layer

name: XR_DXR_mcp_tools
title: App MCP Tools
summary: An app registers its own MCP tools with the runtime's agent surface; calls arrive on the OpenXR event queue

name: XR_DXR_spatial_workspace
title: Spatial Workspace
summary: Multi-app composition: window pose, hit-test, capture, overlay, modal input grab

name: XR_DXR_view_rig
title: View Rig
summary: App declares a display or camera rig descriptor and consumes render-ready XrView{pose, fov}; the runtime owns the projection math

name: XR_DXR_weave
title: Window Weave Service
summary: Window-bound synchronous weave for present-owners: hand the runtime a stereo texture and a window rect, get back a weaved shared texture and a fence

name: XR_DXR_win32_window_binding
title: Win32 Window Binding
summary: App-provided HWND, shared texture, canvas sub-rect

name: XR_DXR_workspace_file_dialog
title: Workspace File Dialog
summary: Async spatial-native file picker spawned by the active workspace controller, with fallback to the platform dialog

name: XR_DXR_xlib_window_binding
title: Xlib Window Binding
summary: App-provided X11 Display* and Window (desktop Linux)
